scope: A0 P1 corrective repair 2A: information durability, ownership, recurrence and non-omniscient public-news foundation
changes: makes PlayerState.knowledge the single mutable player campaign-knowledge ledger
imports and clears legacy CharacterCapabilityState.knowledgeEntries on create/load without a save-schema bump
adds stable claim identity plus observation/refresh/staleness/contradiction/supersession metadata
compacts legacy duplicate semantic claims so refreshed information does not create unbounded parallel rows
makes port assessment refreshable after aging or meaningful change while preserving one claim per port/lens
adds recurring live market rumors sourced from A0.1C authoritative market state
adds physically delayed public event reports sourced from canonical world events
prevents vague old rumors from granting permanent ship identification
makes Korr food-pressure dialogue read live Ironhaven grain state instead of stale authored shortage assumptions
adds optional normalized Supabase player_knowledge metadata migration

cohesion.a0_1a_vessel_lifecycle: unchanged; information/recognition cannot resurrect terminal ships or create another combat outcome owner
cohesion.a0_1b_npc_planner: NPC arrival events are read as potential harbor news only after physical information delay; information never moves or replans NPCs
cohesion.a0_1c_economy: live market stock is read to generate trade information; the information layer never changes inventory, price or economic flow
cohesion.knowledge_owner: PlayerState.knowledge owns mutable player campaign intelligence; legacy character capability knowledge is compatibility input only
cohesion.world_truth: WorldEvent remains canonical truth; KnowledgeRecord describes what the player has learned about that world
cohesion.law_boundary: crime/witness/authority reporting is intentionally excluded from generic public-event propagation until A0.2D
cohesion.navigation: information travel uses active port registry plus the same navigable sea-path/physical-distance foundations
cohesion.character_mind: deterministic local claims read current authoritative state rather than authored stale assumptions
cohesion.expansion: newly activated runtime ports inherit information travel/recurrence through generic registry/path logic, with no named-region engine fork
cohesion.presentation: accepted geometry unchanged; Journal information state wording only

saveCompatibility: schema v12 unchanged; create/load normalizes legacy knowledge ownership in place, and optional normalized Supabase columns are additive
presentationChanged: minimal wording only: Journal can show aging/stale/contradicted/superseded information; no structural UI/art changes
